hints.title: Grid Coordinate Tracking
hints.text: Maintain row index r and column index c starting at the top-left cell zero zero.

hints.title: Delta Movements
hints.text: Execute commands: up decrements row, down increments row, left decrements column, and right increments column.

hints.title: Flattened Cell Index
hints.text: Convert final 2D coordinates (r, c) into standard 1D flattened index using r * n + c.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
